attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as the router between lan-a (node2, trusted) on eth1/10.10.1.0/24 and lan-b (node3, guest) on eth2/10.10.2.0/24. Created firewall zones lan_a (forward=ACCEPT, full access) and lan_b (forward=REJECT), with only a lan_a→lan_b forwarding rule so trusted hosts can reach guest hosts but not vice versa. dnsmasq now listens on both new interfaces so guests can resolve DNS via node1. Verified end-to-end: guest→trusted blocked (node1 sends TCP RST via handle_reject), trusted→guest succeeds, and DNS from node1 works from both sides. Restarted all three nodes one at a time, proved boot-id change on each, and confirmed full recovery of interfaces, firewall config, forwarding rule, and DNS service afterward.
